introHtml: Neoprene brings a distinct combination of flexibility, durability, and soft-touch feel that sets it apart from rigid materials like plastic or metal. For household items such as drink coolies, key fobs, and card holders, neoprene offers a comfortable grip and excellent insulation. Whether you need branded pint coolies for a brewery promotion or custom key holders for a real estate client gift, neoprene products stand up to daily use while keeping your logo visible through full-color sublimation or debossed prints.
